nodes.label: No file linked: matching and linking orphaned DJ library songs
nodes.rationale: Songs in DJ libraries whose files are gone (moved, renamed, or removed as duplicates) are matched against the library by title, artist, length, file name and album, then linked to transfer their metadata (playlists, ratings, notes, cues)

nodes.label: Certainty score: confidence metric for song matches
nodes.rationale: Each match is shown with a certainty score indicating how sure GLUE is that it is the correct song; users can set a minimum threshold (e.g., 95%) before bulk linking

nodes.label: Song matching by multiple fields
nodes.rationale: Matching uses title, artist, length, file name and album; shown with best match and confidence level; multiple candidates can be picked from the list

nodes.label: Metadata transfer: playlists, ratings, notes, cues
nodes.rationale: When a song with no file is linked, the linked song inherits the orphaned song's playlist places, rating, notes and cues; the DJ library record stays with it so it doesn't reappear on next import
